name: strava-hub
description: An open-source Strava foundation platform and mini-app ecosystem

scripts.cdk:synth:dev: cd core/infrastructure && npx cdk synth StravaHubData-dev StravaHubApi-dev StravaHubWeb-dev
scripts.cdk:synth:prod: cd core/infrastructure && npx cdk synth StravaHubData-prod StravaHubApi-prod StravaHubWeb-prod
scripts.cdk:diff:dev: cd core/infrastructure && npx cdk diff StravaHub*-dev
scripts.cdk:deploy:dev: cd core/infrastructure && npx cdk deploy StravaHubData-dev StravaHubApi-dev StravaHubWeb-dev
scripts.cdk:deploy:prod: cd core/infrastructure && npx cdk deploy StravaHubData-prod StravaHubApi-prod StravaHubWeb-prod
